incidents.title: SSH Server Compromise and Data Exfiltration

kill_chain.description: Port scanning activity targeting ssh-srv from external IP 203.0.113.13.
Credential brute-force attack followed by successful login for user deploy from external IP 203.0.113.13.
Large data exfiltration over suspicious port 4444 to external IP 198.51.100.200.

incidents.rationale: Correlated events linked by shared source IP 203.0.113.13, target host ssh-srv, and chronological plausibility encompassing port scan, brute force, successful login, privilege escalation, and outbound data transfer.
